decisions.reason: As a fashion-led decorative devoré line launched in a cluster of similar 2019 products, it is relatively likely to be rationalized if repeat demand was not strong enough after the initial introduction.
A transparent burnout decorative fabric is a narrower, trend-sensitive niche, so management would be fairly likely to discontinue it if volumes remained limited.
This burnout decorative fabric overlaps with other decorative introductions from the same year, making portfolio consolidation somewhat more likely than continuation.
Velour-like upholstery fabric fits a more durable, mainstream furnishing segment and is therefore more likely to stay in the range if quality and customer acceptance are adequate.
A flame-retardant plain inbetween fabric serves a functional niche with compliance value, which usually supports keeping it unless sales were clearly disappointing.
A polyester lining fabric with satin sheen is a basic assortment product that can support steady business, so it is somewhat more likely to be retained than withdrawn.
